extDescription.message: Verify sealed voice recordings offline, and see which seconds were changed. Open protocol, not audited.

popupNote.message: Everything runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

dropHint.message: Drop a WAV file here, or choose one

sender.message: Who claims to have sent it?

needAccess.message: To read this file, Vox Trust needs access to $ARG$. It asks only for that site.

fetchFailed.message: Could not download the file here. Download it and drop it above.

v_verified_text.message: Sealed with the key you pinned for $ARG$, and unchanged since.

v_unsealed_text.message: No seal you can check. That is normal for most audio and does not mean it is fake.

v_warning_text.message: $ARG$ always seals, but this recording has no valid seal from them.

v_alert_text.message: The seal is broken, or comes from a different key than the one you pinned. Do not trust this recording.

unknownKeyIntact.message: Sealed by a key you have not pinned, and unchanged since it was sealed. That says nothing about who sealed it.

unknownKeyAltered.message: Sealed by a key you have not pinned, and altered after it was sealed.

notWav.message: This is not a 16-bit PCM WAV file. Voice messages that apps re-encode lose the seal.

noContacts.message: No contacts yet. Ask each contact for their pairing text.

strict.message: Strict: a missing seal is an alert

invalidPairing.message: That is not a valid pairing text.

circleWarning.message: A circle pairing text contains a shared secret. It is stored only in this browser.
